links.outcome: Readability (FKGL, FRES, GFI) of AI chatbot and DI patient education responses versus recommended levels
links.effect: All resources exceeded recommended FKGL and GFI and fell below FRES of 90 to 100; ChatGPT had higher FKGL than GAO (P < .01) and lower FRES than GAO and DI (P < .01).
links.quote: All resources exceeded the recommended FKGL and GFI scores as well as the FRES of 90 to 100.

links.outcome: Readability of AI-generated patient education responses relative to recommended plain-language levels
links.effect: ChatGPT had a significantly higher FKGL than GAO (P < .01) and a lower FRES than both GAO and DI (P < .01), indicating a more difficult reading level; all resources exceeded recommendations.
links.quote: ChatGPT had a significantly higher FKGL than GAO (P < .01), and a lower FRES than both GAO (P < .01) and DI (P < .01), indicating a more difficult reading level.

screen.reason: Evaluates commercial LLM responses (ChatGPT and Google AI Overview) against Dysphonia International patient education statements for accuracy, readability, and safety without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment intervention.
